what_this_is: An independent, minimal reimplementation of the small part of Roboflow `sports`' public API that this project consumes. NO upstream source was copied.
note: vision/README.md previously stated that this directory held Roboflow `sports` vendored 'at commit <RECORD SHA HERE>'. That description was wrong, not merely incomplete: the module is ~90 lines written against the upstream API shape (its own header has said so since it was written), so there has never been a commit to fill in. Recorded here because an attribution claim is what a licence review reads, and 'vendored MIT code with an unknown revision' and 'our own code matching a third-party interface' carry entirely different obligations. If real upstream source is ever copied in, set copied_code true and record upstream_commit — test_docs_guard.py then requires the SHA and requires the README to name it.
